column1: # Retromon's farm and pet creatures (tools/mons11.py; John's 13:27). Not caught: bought, given or born on your farm.
# The young grow up after days of care, a she into the first, a he into the second. Shown in the Creature Viewer only;
# not in the game yet. (14:40) The dog and the cat come in coats (a breed's colours; one build, one size).

column8: After 7 days of care (fed, brushed, let out to graze): MOOBELLE if she's a she, BRAWNOX if he's a he
column9: Bought at a ranch, or born in your barn to a MOOBELLE and a BRAWNOX
column10: Follows you about the yard; drinks from a bucket you fill. Too young to milk.

column9: Grows from a MOOPIP
column10: MOOMOO MILK each morning (more the happier she is: a full bottle heals 100 HP). Her bell tells you where she's wandered.

column9: Grows from a MOOPIP
column10: Pulls the plough (a field tilled in one go), shifts the farm's boulders. With a MOOBELLE, a calf in the spring.

column8: After 5 days of care: FLEECELLE if she's a she, CURLRAM if he's a he
column9: Bought at a ranch, or born to a FLEECELLE and a CURLRAM
column10: Skips after you; its first fleece too short to shear.

column9: Grows from a LAMBLET
column10: WOOL every 3 days when sheared (sold, or made into clothes at the tailor's). Her bow you can choose.

column9: Grows from a LAMBLET
column10: Butts stumps and rocks out of a field. With a FLEECELLE, lambs.

column8: After 5 days of care: TRUFFLESOW if she's a she, TUSKHOG if he's a he
column9: Bought at a ranch, or a litter in the sty
column10: Roots about in the mud; finds a dropped coin now and then.

column9: Grows from an OINKLET
column10: Walked in the woods, she snuffles out TRUFFLES and buried items (a nose for hidden things).

column9: Grows from an OINKLET
column10: Digs up roots and clears scrub; guards the sty. With a TRUFFLESOW, a litter.

column8: After 3 days of care: CLUCKMAID if she's a she, CROWCOMB if he's a he
column9: Hatched from an egg kept warm in the incubator
column10: Peeps along behind you in a line with the others.

column9: Grows from a PEEPLING
column10: An EGG most mornings in the coop (eaten, sold, or kept warm to hatch).

column9: Grows from a PEEPLING
column10: Crows at dawn: the farm wakes (and so do you, a little earlier). Needed for eggs that hatch.

column8: After 10 days of care (fed, groomed, walked): MAREBRAID if she's a she, STORMSTEED if he's a he

column10: Trots beside you; too young to ride.

column9: Grows from a FOALET

column9: Grows from a FOALET
column10: Ridden fast; jumps fences and low walls. With a MAREBRAID, a foal.
